errors: First site-wage test run used a 12-week x 5-shift brute force that ran past 2 minutes; cut to 6 x 4. A cover-finder test pinned the shift with fixed:, which barred the cover; fixed by covering on unpinned slots.

doc_friction.issue: Heredoc-based python edits containing regex text tripped a built-in rm-safety check ('could not be checked'); the Edit tool worked. Not a repo doc problem, but worth knowing: prefer Edit for regex-heavy changes.

goal: Price a site's pay (city minimum wage, premiums) into the roster with legally correct weighted-average overtime, and measure what it changes.
notes: Landed --site-wage (page field 'Wages by site'): +$/h, +%, min floor per site; overtime on the weighted-average regular rate (29 CFR 778.115). Exact-check floors adjusted for mixed rates (person's least rate for list floors; per-shift pricer floor h*(r - c*(high-r))); brute-force test over 6 tiny random weeks never beats a proven roster. eval/site-wages.mjs on 40 made-up weeks (City $21.30 Seattle 2026 floor, Suburb $17.13 WA 2026 floor, from lni.wa.gov): unpriced roster understated payroll ~5.4%; pricing saved 2.2% (f=1, cheaper in 40/40) and 0.65% (f=0.5, 35 cheaper, 4 same, 1 dearer by $6.64). Headless Chromium check of the page: By site note shows the site-wage line, no page errors. Local checks: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder -> ok (152.0s), 1 suites run, 0 failed; node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs shift-roster-builder -> 'preflight clean for shift-roster-builder', exit 0.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: engineer estimate: weighted-average OT engine change, bound proofs, tests, eval and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
